confidence_notes: Restaurant-meal and coffee anchors rest on user-submitted aggregate listings (Numbeo, Expatica; June 2026 snapshots) and are moderately reliable. Beer is drawn from a reported 0.5 L draught price of about AUD 13.29, scaled to a standard serving. Cocktail and wine_glass were not verifiable from search results, so they use the local beer relationship (cocktail about 1.8x beer, wine glass about 1.1x beer) and are the least certain drink anchors. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and regional Australian context; no accommodation searches or live listings were consulted. Prices reflect the July 2026 window, and central or beachside venues may run above these averages.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Newcastle, NSW, a mid-sized coastal Australian city. Restaurant and coffee prices are anchored to 2026 Newcastle aggregates in AUD and converted at the RBA rate. Accommodation is benchmarked against regional NSW coastal cities of similar size and tourist demand.
